SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(changed_count), 0)::int AS changed,
  COALESCE(SUM(proposed_count), 0)::int AS proposed,
  COUNT(*)::int AS sample_size
FROM claim_metrics WHERE submitted_at > now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (submitted_at - note_signed_at)) / 3600) AS median_hours,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (submitted_at - note_signed_at)) / 3600) AS p90_hours
FROM claim_metrics WHERE submitted_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND note_signed_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM claims WHERE draft_generated_at > now() - interval '30 days')::int AS claims_processed_30d,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM claims WHERE status IN ('pending_review','partially_reviewed'))::int AS pending_doctor_reviews,
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(regeneration_count),0) FROM claims WHERE draft_generated_at > now() - interval '30 days')::int AS regeneration_count_30d,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events WHERE event = 'Code quarantined — validation failed' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days')::int AS validation_failures_30d,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM doc_requests WHERE status NOT IN ('submitted','sla_breach') AND due_at < now() + interval '24 hours')::int AS sla_approaching,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events WHERE event = 'Reconciliation discrepancy found' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days')::int AS reconciliation_discrepancies
